notes.title: Game Release Delayed
notes.notes:
Dear Steam Community,

We regret to inform you that our game release has been delayed once again. While the game is technically ready, we feel it's crucial to conduct thorough bug testing and ensure that our game reaches publishers without any major issues. As a small indie studio, this is our debut title, and we're navigating uncharted territory, striving to deliver the best experience possible. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your patience and understanding.

Thank you for your continued support.

Sincerely,
Hurrycat Studios

notes.title: Madhouse Madness - Community Update 📢
notes.notes:
📢 Steam Announcement: Madhouse Madness - Community Update 📢

Greetings, fearless Madhouse Madness community,

We're thrilled to share some significant updates about Madhouse Madness, all of which have been shaped by your vital input:

🔧 Optimization Underway: Your feedback has been our guiding light. We're actively addressing optimization concerns to provide a smoother, more immersive experience. Expect these enhancements in the near future.

🛠️ New Mechanics and Animations: Get ready for spine-tingling additions! We're crafting fresh gameplay mechanics and animations to intensify your journey through Madhouse Madness. More horrors await.

📆 Release Date Rescheduled: In direct response to your community's feedback, we've made the tough call to delay our release date. Our aim is to ensure that Madhouse Madness meets and exceeds your expectations.

🎵 Music Copyright Solutions: Your concerns regarding music copyrights have not fallen on deaf ears. We're actively working to address these issues to ensure full compliance with copyright regulations.

🎮 Game Design Clarity: We've recognized that there have been misunderstandings and confusion about certain game elements. Expect new updates to provide players with a clearer sense of direction, reducing uncertainty and enhancing the overall experience.

Your support is invaluable, and we're committed to creating a game that truly reflects your expectations. Stay tuned for more updates, exclusive content, and surprises that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

Thank you for being an integral part of the Madhouse Madness community.

Stay spooky,
Hurrycat Studios
